import json, sys
import mod.client.extraClientApi as api
from modern_projection.projection.preview_depth import depth_color
saved = sys._shield_banner_geometry_r20
owner = api.GetSystem('ModernProjection', 'ModernProjectionClientSystem')
saved['packets'] = []
results = []
for index, row in enumerate(saved['controls']):
    tint = saved['node'].CreateChildControl('PyreactBase.image', 'r20v5_packet_%d' % index, None, True)
    assert tint is not None
    saved['packets'].append(tint)
    tint.SetPosition((120. + 50. * index, 62.))
    tint.SetSize((1., 1.))
    tint.SetLayer(119 + 2 * index)
    tint.SetVisible(True)
    image = tint.asImage()
    image.SetSprite('textures/modern_projection/transparent')
    layout = owner.bridge.model_layouts[row['model']]
    color = depth_color(0., owner.session.editor.document.biome, (layout[0][1], layout[1][2]))
    image.SetSpriteColor(color)
    row['control'].SetLayer(120 + 2 * index)
    params = {'block_geometry_model_name': row['model'], 'scale': 4., 'init_rot_x': -90., 'init_rot_y': 0., 'init_rot_z': 0.}
    returned = row['doll'].RenderBlockGeometryModel(params)
    assert returned
    results.append({'label': row['label'], 'layout': layout, 'packet': color, 'returned': returned})
_result = json.dumps({'results': results})
